d: Successful planning, execution, and completion of the projects. This role involves managing all aspects of the projects, including design, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Collaborates with various stakeholders, including clients, contractors, architects, and vendors, to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards.
Adhere to all safety and compliance rules of the company.
Convening the project meetings to review progress to attain the targeted completion schedule.
Enforcing the compliance regulations for the installation or related works.
Ensuring the approved Quality Assurance Plan for this project are implemented and followed by the Project Team.
Coordinate with factory for commercial matters related to NOC’s.
Acquiring additional information or clarifying available information with consultant if the requirements are not clearly defined.
Discussing with the consultant with respect to the drawing / specification / submittals whenever required.
Ensuring manufacturer is properly informed of the concluded specifications.
Drafting and administering the Design Quality Assurance Plan.
Following up with customers / consultants for getting the layout drawings approved and finalizing the specifications and finishes.
Raising invoices for advance payments as per the conditions of the contracts and collecting the payments.
Implement the Health, Safety & Environment (QHSE) process in all activities of the Company.
To Make sure that workers and subcontractors obtain their permits to work.
Obtain permits for importing equipment and manage all logistical transport equipment’s from the factory to job site safely.
Monitor the use of personal protective equipment’s by all employees, as applicable.
Ensure that all accidents, near misses and defects are reported and corrective and preventive action is taken against them.
Coordination with other inter and / or departmental resources for infrastructure, transport, tools and any other day to day operational requirements.
Creates and maintains safety and security awareness amongst employees and sub-contractors. Ensures company’s safety and security policies.
Daily time collection and reporting in system
Perform other tasks assigned by the direct manager which include but not limited to the above-mentioned duties.
Responsible to implement QHSE Policy requirements in their Project area.
Establish QHSE objectives and targets to meet the Company QHSE Objectives and QHSE Plan
Establish procedures and controls to ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with the QHSE Management System
Identification of training needs to enable all personnel to meet QHSE Objectives and QHSE targets
Ensure that all Operational Controls for High Risk and Significant Aspects are communicated to all employees and contractors and complied with.
Ensure that All Legal and Regulatory requirements at Site are complied with.
Establish methods for consultation with all employees on QHSE matters.
Carry out all work activities in safe manner.
Follow all QHSE Procedures and controls.
Use and maintain Personal Protective Equipment’s provided by the Company.
Respect and don’t remove collective protections and safeguards.
Promptly report all accidents and near misses to the immediate Superior and QHSE team
Report all defects and events which may affect QHSE control.
Respond correctly and as per QHSE guidelines during Emergency situations.
Actively support and co-operate with other employees in QHSE matters.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably mechanical / electrical engineer)
Professional certificate in project management i.e., PMP is a plus.
At least 3 years of experience in managing major projects independently.
Proven working experience as a Project Engineer
Excellent knowledge of design and visualization software such as AutoCAD
Knowledge of project management computer packages i.e., MS Project and Primavera is an added advantage.
Familiarity with rules, regulations, best practices, and performance standards
Ability to work with multiple discipline projects.
Decision making ability and leadership skills.
